answer: Stop sybils with an ocean ledge: each agent climbs to a ledge by clearing a public work threshold. Its quill signature, a key-signed proof, is verifier-checked; a signature reused across two identities voids both and slashes the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 workloads and signatures at 17x honest cost each: each signature fits one agent and one ledge, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents climb once and trade undiluted.
